description: Check whether a saved interaction recipe still applies to the current version of a page — Compares a recipe (ordered steps naming selectors from an earlier dom-skeleton call), the saved skeleton elements those selectors came from, and the current page HTML. Per step it reports matched (same selector, same tag, type, role and name), changed (selector still exists but the element differs), moved (the same element now has a different selector, given as newSelector), ambiguous (several cur

selector.description: A selector from the saved skeleton.

saved.description: elements from an earlier dom-skeleton response.

name.description: Best-effort accessible name (aria-label, aria-labelledby, label, text, placeholder, title, alt, value), at most 80 characters.

repeats.description: Elements with the same tag, type, role, name and href collapsed into this one (the first).

selector.description: CSS selector that matches exactly this element in the supplied HTML.

name: dom-recipe-match
